body_markdown:
#### RepoAgent will deliver greater efficiency and liquidity benefits to the bilateral repo market


LSEG and Tradeweb today announce the launch of RepoAgent, a new solution designed to streamline post-trade processing for the non-cleared repo market. RepoAgent, part of LSEG’s Post Trade Solutions business, is the first open access solution of its kind to deliver a straight-through, no-touch repo workflow from trade execution to settlement instruction, promoting the electronification of post-trade repo workflows.


The automated process marks a significant advancement in post-trade efficiency and the ongoing modernisation of market infrastructure. It helps reduce costs and manual processing, while providing market participants with greater automation and settlement efficiency as the industry prepares for T+1 and increasingly compressed post-trade timelines. BlueCrest, J.P. Morgan and Citi are among the first institutions engaging with the solution for repo transactions executed on Tradeweb.


RepoAgent receives matched bilateral repo trades from Tradeweb and performs automated netting and shaping for each dealer-client relationship before sending matched instructions to the nominated Central Securities Depository (CSD) on behalf of the counterparties. This helps improve settlement efficiency, optimise intraday liquidity usage, reduce fails and CSDR-related penalties for clients and dealers, and deliver a solution aligned with industry-wide guidelines ahead of Europe’s adoption of T+1.


The service currently supports euro-denominated repo transactions settling in the Euroclear and Clearstream ICSDs, with plans to support additional currencies and products, and connect to other CSDs and trading venues.


**Jamie Gavin, Head of Agent Services, Post Trade Solutions, LSEG** , commented: “RepoAgent brings the proven efficiencies of clearing to the uncleared repo market, enabling participants to optimise liquidity, reduce settlement risk and lower costs. It reflects our ongoing commitment to modernising post-trade infrastructure through scalable, client-centric solutions.”


**Nicola Danese, Co-Head of International Developed Markets at Tradeweb** , said: “RepoAgent extends Tradeweb’s electronic execution capabilities from the point of trade to deliver meaningful post-trade efficiencies for our clients. By streamlining historically manual workflows, such as pair-offs, the solution reduces friction and enables full straight-through processing in the bilateral repo market, particularly as markets move towards shorter settlement cycles.”


**BlueCrest Capital Management** said: “We are pleased to be among the early adopters of RepoAgent as it is introduced to the market, marking a positive step in improving post-trade efficiency in the repo space. Solutions that reduce manual processes and enhance time efficiency are increasingly important, and RepoAgent supports our ongoing focus on operating more effectively as markets evolve and continue to electronify.”


**Mike Charnley, Global Head of Prime & Delta One Middle Office, Citi** , said: “RepoAgent provides clients straightforward access to a unique front-to-back solution, connecting trade execution with automated post-trade processing and settlement instruction. Matched bilateral repo trades are auto netted and shaped, reducing manual touch points, improving settlement efficiency and help clients meet the compressed operational demands of T+1.”


**Maheer Trivedi, Global Head of Fixed Income Financing, J.P. Morgan** , said: “Innovation in market infrastructure is important to delivering increasingly efficient and scalable solutions for our clients. RepoAgent can help simplify bilateral repo post-trade workflows, and is designed to reduce operational friction and settlement risk while supporting our broader desire of driving greater automation and efficiency across the market.”

**About Post Trade Solutions**


Post Trade Solutions brings together Acadia, Quantile, SwapAgent, TradeAgent and RepoAgent to streamline operations, reduce risk and improve capital efficiency.


By connecting with existing cleared infrastructure, we bring the benefits of clearing to the bilateral space, driving efficiency no matter where customers choose to trade their risk.


We continually innovate and have combined our solutions into five pillars which streamline workflows and operations, centralise data on open-access platforms and provide an authoritative data store, optimise to reduce risk and improve capital efficiency, analyse to simplify regulatory compliance, and advise our community to solve the industry’s most complex challenges.


Post Trade Solutions is part of LSEG’s Markets division. Our network includes over 3,000 firms, including all the top dealer banks, regional banks, buy-side firms and corporates.
